
{{alias}}( [out] )
    Returns an accumulator function which incrementally computes a minimum and
    maximum absolute value, ignoring `NaN` values.

    If provided a value, the accumulator function returns an updated minimum
    and maximum. If not provided a value, the accumulator function returns the
    current minimum and maximum.

    Any `NaN` values provided to the accumulator are ignored, and do not
    affect the accumulated result.

    Parameters
    ----------
    out: Array|TypedArray (optional)
        Output array.

    Returns
    -------
    acc: Function
        Accumulator function.

    Examples
    --------
    > var accumulator = {{alias}}();
    > var mm = accumulator()
    null
    > mm = accumulator( 2.0 )
    [ 2.0, 2.0 ]
    > mm = accumulator( NaN )
    [ 2.0, 2.0 ]
    > mm = accumulator( -5.0 )
    [ 2.0, 5.0 ]
    > mm = accumulator( 3.0 )
    [ 2.0, 5.0 ]
    > mm = accumulator()
    [ 2.0, 5.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
